meta.title: Historia-globen – see what happened at the same time around the world
meta.description: Explore world history on a spinning globe. Drag through time and see what happened at the same time in different parts of the world.

help.title: How to use the globe
help.s1t: Spin it with your finger or the mouse. Pinch or scroll to zoom.
help.s2t: Tap the year or drag the timeline.
help.s3t: Choose a war, an empire or a religion under Focus.
help.m1: All events have the same brass medal. The symbol and the inner colour show the category.
help.m2: The arc under the medal is a small timeline. The whole arc: ongoing in the year you are at. Left part: has already happened. Right part: comes later. The arc shows when you zoom in.
help.m4: Dashed arc: uncertain information (approximate year or sources that differ).
help.m5: Cluster: the number is the number of events, and the colours of the ring show the categories. With the mouse pointer over the cluster, or when you go to it with Tab, you see what it contains, for example “3 war events, 2 empires and civilisations”.
help.m6: Religions (in Layers): the symbol in an area and next to the colour shows the religion, for example a cross for Christianity. A medal with the symbol stands where the religion arose. It appears in the year the religion arose and stays as long as the religion layer is on. Click it to read about the religion. Point at a religion in the lists or in the legend to highlight it on the map.
help.m7: Empires: a medal in the middle of an empire shows its symbol, for example the eagle for Rome. Point at it to see the name and click it to read about the empire. When you zoom in, the name stands under the symbol.
